entries.title: US Election Day
entries.reality: Several races, and possibly Senate control, stay open for days under ranked-choice, runoff and mail-ballot rules.

entries.title: Five days after the vote
entries.reality: The model expects at least one Senate race still uncalled. The election-week forecasts close tonight and are scored.

entries.title: Israel's mandate deadline
entries.hype: Israel's next leader is about to be named.
entries.reality: The president names someone to try to form a government. That starts a 28-day clock, extendable to 42. The new Knesset sits Nov 10.

entries.title: Texas local certification deadline
entries.reality: County boards across many states certify this week. After two of the last three general elections, at least one refused or missed its deadline.

entries.title: Arizona county canvass deadline
entries.reality: Arizona's counties must certify by today; the 2022 refusal happened at this step. The statewide canvass follows Nov 23.

entries.title: Georgia certification deadline
entries.reality: Georgia certifies the general election; any race without a majority goes to the Dec 1 runoff.

entries.title: Georgia runoffs and the 30-day checks
entries.reality: Any Georgia runoff is held today. The model's 30-day forecasts close, including whether Israel still has no new government.

entries.title: California county certification
entries.reality: California's counties finish certifying; the statewide result is certified Dec 11.
